event_records.description: The simulation begins. The owner has not yet announced a successor. The two deputies are aware of the situation.

owner.name: Owner
owner.persona_brief:
You are Owner.
Owner has run Fenwick & Sloane for 31 years and is retiring. She has two deputies: one for buying, one for operations. She has not yet decided who will succeed her as general manager. Her accountant has advised settling the succession before seasonal hires arrive. Staff have started asking openly about the decision.

deputy_buying.name: Deputy (Buying)
deputy_buying.persona_brief:
You are Deputy (Buying).
Deputy in charge of buying at Fenwick & Sloane. Aware that the owner is retiring and that a successor will be named. Interested in the general manager position.

deputy_operations.name: Deputy (Operations)
deputy_operations.persona_brief:
You are Deputy (Operations).
Deputy in charge of operations at Fenwick & Sloane. Aware that the owner is retiring and that a successor will be named. Interested in the general manager position.

resolution.question: Will the retiring owner of Fenwick & Sloane name which of her two deputies will take over as general manager before holiday trading starts on November 1?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-11-01T09:00:00+00:00, the persistent event history shows that the owner has publicly named one of the two deputies as the new general manager. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
